speaker: Doctor
text: I've heard you've been dealing with chronic diarrhea and lower abdominal discomfort. To better understand your condition, could you tell me how long you've been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 31-year-old female. The patient reports experiencing chronic diarrhea on most days for the past four months. She mentions lower abdominal discomfort and cramping, which is relieved by diarrhea. The patient notes the bowel movements are urgent, occasionally accompanied by mucus discharge, and often followed by a feeling of incomplete evacuation. She went camping several months ago and recalls another member of the camping party falling ill recently.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; the relief of symptoms after bowel movements and the feeling of incomplete evacuation are very specific. Given your camping trip and others falling ill, do you think anyone else in your current household or family has developed similar symptoms recently?

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Infectious Colitis (likely Shigella or Campylobacter) with post-infectious Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS-D).

REQUEST TEST: Stool Culture and Ova & Parasites.
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_XRay.
